questions: comparison with framed A1 including failures
specification.independent_unit: payload/context group; 20 per direction, not 60 methods
specification.bootstrap: percentile; resample whole groups within image class or UTF-8 length band; carry methods and owned shared controls together
specification.recovery_interval: two-sided Clopper-Pearson exact binomial, including 0/n and n/n; Bernoulli working-model interval for a small fixed stratified sample
specification.paired_binary_boundary_bound: difference of 97.5% marginal Clopper-Pearson intervals (Bonferroni conservative); also retain paired grouped bootstrap
specification.goodput: incomplete or unauthenticated transmissions have zero exact goodput; packet-prefix progress is separate
specification.score_scope: whole delivered carrier; model/context-aware observer; no packet-boundary features or extra scoring passes
specification.auc: empirical pairwise wins plus half ties; matched ordinary controls; include failed delivered carriers when scorable
specification.duplicates: deduplicate identical control artifact hashes within each direction/method cell; lowest frozen group ordinal owns it; retain other links without extra negatives; repeated bootstrap draws retain owner multiplicity
specification.unscorable: explicit missing carrier/control/whole score; never replace or infer scores
plots: whole-carrier score AUC with grouped intervals

limitations: 20 frozen, stratified payload groups per direction; not a representative population or statistical-power claim
Exact-binomial recovery bounds use a Bernoulli working model; group bootstrap preserves allocated class/length strata
Collapsed paired bootstrap intervals describe observed data only; binary differences also have conservative boundary-aware bounds
AUC uses frozen higher-is-stego scores, including values below .5; no sign/threshold chosen from held-out labels
Inline mean surprisal/log2-rank under the known model/context are exploratory observers, not unknown-detector or human security
